overall_summary: Data volume is very low, yielding low-to-moderate confidence. However, a clear repeating pattern emerges: husband-wife relationship dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad' and 'पत्नी की ये बात') significantly outperform general heartbreak or family member videos by roughly 6x to 10x in views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) generated nearly 10x the views of standard content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship friction, unspoken domestic expectations, and emotional distance after marriage.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Heavy Shayari & Extended Family Tropes
weak_patterns.evidence: General poetry titles like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा…' got 17 views, and specific sibling/family videos averaged under 200 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic rants or overdone general family member tropes; ground emotional friction in specific modern couple scenarios.

next_video.hook_style: Unspoken distance in the same room
next_video.concept: A husband and wife sitting in total silence scrolling on phones, realizing they know everything about their colleagues' lives but nothing about each other's day anymore.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound of a phone notification breaking a heavy silence in a dark bedroom at 11 PM.
next_video.twist_direction: The realization that physical closeness means nothing when emotional distance has already made them strangers living under one roof.
next_video.reason: Matches the proven high-performing posting time and topic category of husband-wife relationship friction.

experiment: Testing a modern domestic communication failure hook to see if it matches the high engagement seen in previous husband-wife relationship shorts.
